## RE:volution Mod v1.3.12

### Added

- Added deterministic Location stage provisioning backed by REBuilder templates, including coordinate-based `/location create <locationId> <mobSlotId> [x y z]` and deterministic internal seed derivation.
- Added automatic transition-point planning, trigger provisioning, remote unloaded-chunk preparation, multi-ticket Forge chunk leases, rollback support, and exact player anchoring during REBuilder prepare/build.
- Added canonical stage mob identities `Mob<location>_<slot>` with automatic default definitions (`HP=1`, `coins x1`) and initial population `1`, while preserving already customized mob definitions.
- Added automatic Location boss topology: the final configured stage is the runtime boss and is persisted as the only `BOSS_ZONE`; adding a later stage moves boss status automatically.
- Added the complete 41-slot Location 1 appearance roster with static PNG textures and documented Minecraft 1.12.2 six-face UV contracts.
- Added regression coverage for Location provisioning, canonical mob bootstrap, boss topology, progression, REBuilder failure/rollback paths, static resource contracts, and DEV publication routing.

### Fixed

- Fixed remote Location builds failing on unloaded chunks or templates spanning more chunks than one Forge ticket can retain.
- Fixed REBuilder builds using the administrator's original position instead of the requested remote stage anchor.
- Fixed stage transition behavior around trigger crossing, fast-auto separation, unloaded destination chunks, and post-teleport cooldown handling.
- Fixed Location 1 custom mob hitboxes and static texture mapping/readability, including restoration of the known-good moss turtle texture baseline.
- Fixed existing/test Location 1 populations so stages reconcile to their canonical `Mob1_N` identity without resetting later canonical count edits.
- Fixed boss assignment so progression, admin-visible zone type, travel-menu labeling, and persisted topology agree on the final configured stage.

### Other

- Existing Location 1 stages are reconciled without recreating stage geometry, transition points, trigger topology, or world builds.
- Appearance routing remains based on Location + mob slot catalog data; technical `MobL_N` names do not select client models or textures.
- Manual `/stage location setboss` and `clearboss` commands remain available for compatibility, but normal Location provisioning no longer requires manual boss assignment.
- This release keeps the visual goal at a stable, readable test-ready baseline; stronger per-variant art polish is deferred to a later version.

### Download

Download `RE-volution-1.3.12.jar` from the assets attached to this GitHub Release. Use the matching release on server and modded clients.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.11...v1.3.12
